# Third-party code

## SuperSonic 0.71.0: SuperCollider's scsynth in the browser

By Sam Aaron, <https://github.com/samaaron/supersonic>. Plays the pipe
SynthDefs (`sound/organ_synthdefs.scd`) for the demo organ and the preview.
